built: Benchmark design (docs/vision/BENCHMARK.json) and a pure scorer over scoped views. score_view(big, scope, gold_case) scores view(big, scope) per element type (reactions, enzymes, transports, interactions, compartments): recall always, precision only for types the case declares complete, extension-row precision, recovered_by_extension, and a provenance-kind breakdown ('primary' partitions the predicted elements, 'any' counts every kind an element carries). run_benchmark(cases, {case: {run: big}}, scope) gives legs plus a micro aggregate per case kind (paper and full never pooled). Gold builders: gold_from_supplement (paper kind, from gold_v2 / paper_gold supplements), gold_from_pathbank (full kind, from a pathbank_gold.extract payload, no I/O), build_full_gold (accession -> extract through an injectable extractor; the only DB read). Matching reuses eval_v2: match_reaction, _row_key, matcher.strict/candidate/enzyme keys, plus an identifier bridge over payload.grounded_ids.

proofs.default_view_equals_eval_v2: On all 33 stored runs of the gold papers with a final_mapped.json (PMC12096016 29, PMC12312563 2, PMC12421875 2) the DEFAULT-view reaction numbers (recalled, gold, correct, predicted) equal eval_v2 reactions.score_leg table 1 on the same payload. With no extension DEFAULT == base, so these are today's numbers. 25 of those legs are in the committed docs/evaluation_v2/sample_report.json and recall and true-positive count equal it on all 25 (precision denominators differ by design where that report excludes external-lineage rows; this scorer does not use lineage).
proofs.paper_only_vs_default_reactions: micro over the 33 scored runs of certified gold papers (PMC12657337 has no run, so 3 papers): recall 155/165 = 0.9394 in both views; precision PAPER_ONLY 161/176 = 0.9148, DEFAULT 161/183 = 0.8798. The paper-only view drops 7 non-paper rows without losing a true positive.
proofs.full_set: PW701720 (committed extract, no database) against the stored Ara run PMC11983282: reactions 0/1 (curated step is araC gene -> AraC protein, the run extracts transcription and binding), interactions 1/7 recalled of 24 predicted, compartments 1/1. FULL == DEFAULT == PAPER_ONLY because there is no extension: this is the paper-payload baseline; recovered_by_extension is 0 and extension precision None by construction.
